# STOOK RUNNER

Scary Lauren has Princess Rachael. Two Stooks. Eight worlds. One way home.

## A little jump goes a long way.

Hold Shift or X + a direction to run. X also throws bottles when powered up. Hold jump to go higher; release for a short hop. Land on enemies from above.

### The secret stuff

Press down on a marked pipe, or climb a vine with up. In a secret room, walk into the EXIT â pipe or press down on top of it. You can also press R or tap Return to road at any time. Roadside up-arrow signs lead to detours. The halfway pennant saves your place after a fall.

### At the castles

Run and jump past Scary Lauren to pull the bridge lever, or hit her with five water bottles. The coffee worker wakes up after you cross. Rachael is in the final castle.

### Two Stooks

Stook 1 and Stook 2 take turns after a lost life. Each has their own score, lives, and route progress. Both use the same controls. A controller works too: A jumps; B runs and throws.

### A little salon flair

Lauren, Monica, and Marni bring their salon tools. The castles have dressing mirrors and product shelves. A fresh gel finish shines, and a Fabulous makeover leaves a trail of glamour. Enemy contact cannot hurt you during Fabulous mode; pits still need a good jump.

### The soundtrack

Original 8-bit music changes with the road, harbor, salons, secret rooms, and Fabulous mode. Sound starts when you start playing. Use Sound on / off above to mute.

### Meet the trouble
